title: My Favorite Comic
text:
Tom likes comic strips. He reads one every morning in the newspaper. His favorite comic has a dog and a cat. The dog is funny and the cat is lazy.

Tom draws his own comics too. He draws in a small notebook. His comics are short and have only three pictures. His sister always laughs when she reads them.

questions.text: What does Tom read every morning?
Where does Tom draw his comics?
How does Tom probably feel about comics?
options: He does not know what they are

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom's sister probably?
options: She has a good sense of humor

vocabulary.definition: a short story told in pictures and words
a small book with empty pages for writing or drawing
makes sounds that show something is funny

paragraph_translations: Tom lubi komiksy. Czyta jeden każdego ranka w gazecie. Jego ulubiony komiks ma psa i kota. Pies jest zabawny, a kot jest leniwy.
Tom też sam rysuje komiksy. Rysuje w małym zeszycie. Jego komiksy są krótkie i mają tylko trzy obrazki. Jego siostra zawsze się śmieje, kiedy je czyta.
